g.text: Genomes and origins are counted separately (origins: NCBI taxonomy, minimum changes; genomes: confirmatory species).

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: C33 + UAA=Stop: supported 9 genomes, 4 fish lineages (4 origins) | unconfirmed 4 genomes, 4 origins | dropped 1 genome (Globodera), 1 origin.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: G33 + UAA=Stop: supported 2 species in 1 genus (Craniella), 1 origin | dropped 1 genome (Bufotes), 1 origin. All 17 non-U33: 17 genomes, 11 origins.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: UAA=Tyr: calibration panel, about 5 origins (not new). Non-panel: 1 genome (Rotylenchulus), blocked under the locked rules; P. goodeyi is supported weak only.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The tree is NCBI taxonomy (phylum to genus); it is not a molecular phylogeny, and branch lengths have no meaning. Status words come from post-hoc audits.
